messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the building corner are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? We would like this closed out ahead of the next submittal deadline. There may be a cost impact if a change to the specified material is required. This is not holding up any current work. There is no specific deadline for this, but a timely response is appreciated.

Sheet A-201 is the condition to build to for the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the building corner; we'll reconcile Door and Window Schedule A-601 by addendum. There may be a cost impact if a change to the specified material is required. This is not holding up any current work.
